summary: 明帝养子即位，年甫八岁，权归曹爽司马懿；高平陵变后司马氏专权，嘉平六年被废为齐王。
summary_en: Adopted heir of Emperor Ming, he came to the throne at eight, power resting with Cao Shuang and Sima Yi; after the Gaopingling incident Sima's house ruled alone, and in the 6th year of Jiaping he was deposed as Prince of Qi.

portrait.appearance_basis: 史载无形貌描写。画像宜表现冲龄即位、少年被废的君主之态，衣冠从曹魏正始制。属艺术想象。

timeline.title: 生
timeline.summary: 明帝养子，一说任城王楷之子，母不详。
timeline.summary_en: Adopted son of Emperor Ming, said to be a son of Cao Kai of Rencheng; his mother is unknown.

timeline.title: 即位
timeline.summary: 明帝疾笃立为皇太子，寻即帝位，改元正始；曹爽、司马懿辅政。
timeline.summary_en: Made heir in Emperor Ming's last illness, he took the throne and changed the era to Zhengshi, with Cao Shuang and Sima Yi as regents.

timeline.date_note: 正始十年正月改元嘉平
timeline.date_note_en: 1st month, 10th year of Zhengshi, era changed to Jiaping
timeline.title: 高平陵之变
timeline.summary: 司马懿趁帝与爽谒陵，矫诏收兵权，诛曹爽三族，魏权尽归司马氏。
timeline.summary_en: While the emperor and Cao Shuang were at the tombs, Sima Yi seized the armies on forged edicts and exterminated Shuang's kin; Wei's power passed wholly to the Simas.

timeline.title: 王凌谋废立败
timeline.summary: 太尉王凌谋立楚王彪，事泄，司马懿收凌，凌自杀。
timeline.summary_en: The grand commandant Wang Ling plotted to set up Prince Biao of Chu; the plot leaked, Sima Yi seized him, and Ling took his own life.

timeline.title: 李丰张缉谋泄
timeline.summary: 中书令李丰等谋除司马师，事泄族诛，牵连及帝舅张缉。
timeline.summary_en: The palace secretary Li Feng and others plotted against Sima Shi; the plot leaked, they were executed with their kin, and the emperor's uncle Zhang Ji was swept in.

timeline.title: 废为齐王
timeline.summary: 司马师以帝荒淫无度，奏请太后废帝，芳出居齐王位。
timeline.summary_en: Sima Shi, charging the emperor with dissolute excess, petitioned the empress dowager to depose him; Fang was set aside as Prince of Qi.

relations.note: 景初三年明帝崩，养子芳即位
relations.note_en: In Jingchu 3, Emperor Ming dies and his adopted son Fang takes the throne

relations.note: 嘉平六年被废，立高贵乡公
relations.note_en: Deposed in the sixth year of Jiaping; the Duke of Gaoguixiang was enthroned

bio_md:
# 齐王芳 · 主要事迹

曹芳字兰卿，明帝养子，一说任城王曹楷之子。景初三年正月，明帝疾笃，立为皇太子，寻即帝位，年八岁，改元正始，曹爽、司马懿并受遗诏辅政。正始十年正月，帝与曹爽兄弟谒高平陵，司马懿以太后诏勒兵，收其兵权，诛曹爽三族——史称高平陵之变。自此魏之政柄尽归司马氏，帝徒居大位而已。

其后王凌谋立楚王彪，事泄自杀；李丰、张缉等欲除司马师，亦被族诛。帝自即位至废，正始、嘉平两朝，凡十五年间，外朝之变皆系司马家之兴替，帝无一语得与。嘉平六年，司马师以帝「荒淫无度」奏废，芳出为齐王，迁居河内。

正元元年，高贵乡公曹髦即位，芳以齐王终其身。晋泰始十年薨，晋以王礼葬。史家论齐王芳：以冲龄践祚，本无可为，而「曹爽之诛，实启司马之篡」——高平陵一役，不独废一人、易一君，乃曹魏国祚之所系。芳之见废，史称其自取，然冲主何罪，权臣之欲而已。

> 参考：点校本《三国志》卷004《三少帝纪》、卷009《曹爽传》、卷044《司马懿传》。

bio_parts_en.value:
Cao Fang, styled Lanqing, was Emperor Ming's adopted son, said to be a son of Cao Kai of Rencheng. In the first month of the 3rd year of Jingchu, in Ming's last illness, he was named crown prince and at once took the throne at eight, changing the era to Zhengshi, with Cao Shuang and Sima Yi as co-regents by the late edict. In the first month of the 10th year of Zhengshi, while the emperor and Shuang paid homage at the Gaopingling tombs, Sima Yi seized the armies on forged decrees and exterminated Shuang's kin — the Gaopingling incident. From that day Wei's government lay with the Simas, and the emperor sat on the throne without a voice.

Wang Ling's plot to set up Prince Biao of Chu failed, and Ling took his own life; Li Feng and Zhang Ji, plotting against Sima Shi, were executed with their kin. Through Zhengshi and Jiaping, fifteen years, every turn of court affairs was the rise and fall of Sima's house, and the emperor had not one word in it. In the 6th year of Jiaping, Sima Shi petitioned the empress dowager to depose Fang for "dissolute excess"; Fang was set aside as Prince of Qi and moved to Henei.

The Duke of Gaogui District succeeded him, and Fang lived out his days as Prince of Qi, dying in the 10th year of Jin Taishi. The historians' judgment: a child sovereign could do nothing, yet the slaying of Cao Shuang began the Sima usurpation — the Gaopingling incident deposed more than one man; it was the fate of the Wei dynasty. Fang's fall was blamed on himself by the official historians, but a child emperor's "fault" was only the strong minister's will.

> References: the punctuated critical edition of the *Sanguozhi*, ch. 4 ("Annals of the Three Young Sovereigns"), ch. 9 (biography of Cao Shuang), ch. 44 (biography of Sima Yi).
